subject: Finalizing invoice delivery method, cutoff windows, and PO mapping
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finwell.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@finwell.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice delivery & PO mapping requirements

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. Before we move to go-live we'd like to lock down a few operational details so our AP team can reconcile automatically:

- Invoice delivery: prefer portal pull (sFTP/API) but need an email copy with PDF/XML attachment to ap@finwell.com for our ERP ingestion.
- Cutoff window: our ERP processes invoices daily at 02:00 CET; any invoices uploaded after that get included in next day's batch. Can you confirm Redwood's invoice generation cutoff?
- PO mapping: we require the invoice to include PO number in header and each line item to include a matching PO-line if provided.
- VAT evidence: for reverse charge invoices we need a field with the VAT basis and the declaration text.

Can you confirm these are feasible and share a sample XML and timeline for implementation?

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance Operations
FinWell Inc.

---

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & PO mapping requirements

Hi Elena — thanks, this is clear and sensible. Short answers up front, then proposed options: 

1) Portal vs email: We can support both. Recommended setup: primary channel = secure portal/API (push or pull) + automated email copy with PDF and e-invoice XML attached to ap@finwell.com. That gives your ERP the attachments it needs while keeping a single source of truth in our portal.

2) Cutoff windows: Redwood currently runs invoice batch generation at 00:30 UTC daily. Converting that to CET gives 02:30 CET (03:30 during DST). We can shift generation by +/-1 hour for account-level configs when needed.

3) PO mapping: We will include a PO header field and include an optional PO-line mapping element in the XML. If you need line-level enforcement, we can turn on a validation rule that rejects or flags billing lines without a matching PO-line.

4) VAT evidence: we can include an explicit VAT_evidence block in the XML and include the text required for reverse charge in the PDF. We will also populate the invoice meta with tax jurisdiction and reverse-charge flag.

Next steps (proposed):
- We will share an example XML + PDF template (attached)
- You confirm PO field names and whether line-level enforcement is required
- We schedule a 30-min ops call to finalize cutoff and webhook settings

I'll attach a sample XML and remittance template for your AP team to review.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Strategic Accounts (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Attachment: fc_invoice_sample.xml (example e-invoice), remittance_instructions_template.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 13:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Internal: PO validation and cutoff nuance for FinWell

Sofia / Marissa — quick internal note to capture implementation constraints: 

- Cutoff: account-level shift to 01:30 UTC (02:30 CET) is doable; pushing later into CET (03:30) requires a 90-minute ops window adjustment but still possible. Recommend 01:30 UTC to align with FinWell's 02:00 CET processing and give them a 30-min buffer.
- Timezone: FinWell is CET; need to confirm DST handling. Add a flag in our account config to auto-adjust for DST.
- Webhook: offer two options — push to their API (HMAC-signed) on generation OR provide sFTP drop with file naming convention FIWLL_INV_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.xml. We should support both by default.
- Attachments: include both PDF and XML in email copy. Note that some ERPs prefer XML-only. We should make attachments configurable per billing contact.

I'll prepare a short configuration checklist for the ops call.

K
Kimberly Park
Billing Integrations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finwell.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@finwell.com>, Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@finwell.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:19:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & PO mapping requirements

Hi Sofia / Kimberly — thanks for the fast response. We agree to the combined approach (portal primary + email copy). A few clarifications: 

- Final cutoff: we'll accept 02:30 CET generation as long as the email copy lands by 03:00 CET (our ERP ingest runs at 03:15 CET on go-live day to allow manual checks).
- PO fields: Please use header field po_number and optional line element po_line_ref. For enforcement, start with a soft-flag (warning) for missing line-level mapping for the first month, then enforce if gaps persist.
- VAT: we will provide the reverse charge declaration text. Please include the VAT_evidence element with a reference to our VAT reg number.
- Security: webhook must support HMAC signatures; sFTP credentials will be provided if we go that route.

We reviewed the attachments you sent — xml looks fine at a glance. Two asks:
1) Can you add our ERP reference ID in the filename for the sFTP option (ERP=FW-ERP01)?
2) Can you confirm that invoices older than 24 months will remain accessible in the portal for audit?

Once we have the checklist and a short ops call, we can sign off.

Best,
Elena

---

Hi Elena — perfect. Confirming items and next steps below (Mutual Action Plan):

1) Invoice generation cutoff: set to 01:30 UTC (02:30 CET) account-level. Email copy will be dispatched immediately after generation; target delivery by 03:00 CET.
2) Delivery channels: primary = portal/API (pull), fallback = sFTP drop and email copy. Filenames for sFTP will follow: FW-ERP01_INV_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.xml (per your request).
3) Attachments: email copy will contain both PDF and XML. We will expose a config toggle if you prefer XML-only for specific recipients.
4) PO mapping: header = po_number; optional po_line_ref at line-level. Start with soft-flagging missing line-level mappings for 30 days.
5) VAT evidence: include VAT_evidence element and your provided declaration text (please upload to the shared Drive link).
6) Data retention: portal retains invoices for 7 years by default; we will grant FinWell 24-month export snapshot accessible via the portal or via a one-time bulk export.

Action items: 
- Elena: drop the reverse charge declaration text and confirm whether you want XML-only for ap@finwell.com or PDF+XML (deadline: 2027-05-14 EOD).
- Marissa/Kim: prepare the account config (cutoff, filenames, webhook HMAC) and a one-page ops checklist; schedule 30-min call for 2027-05-14 09:30 CET.

I'll follow up with a Doc (Drive) and a short checklist link.

Thanks,
Sofia
